summary: Ongoing Snowflake Software Development and Improvements
description:
### Description
Provide ongoing software development for Snowflake, covering a mix of new development, enhancements, fixes, and operational improvements across all Snowflake software initiatives.

### Expected Value
Enable Snowflake software to evolve in response to development needs while improving existing capabilities and addressing defects and operational issues.

### Measurement of Value
Measurement is based on the successful delivery and validation of approved Snowflake software development work, including enhancements, fixes, and operational improvements.
